bio: Jim DeCoste (MB / CFA) is a Mortgage Broker with Dominion Lending Centres Maritime Mortgage Group in Antigonish, Nova Scotia. The site is a standard DLC template covering purchase, refinance, renewal, home equity, CHIP, self-employed and commercial, plus current rate comparisons. It states DLC has over 2,300 members and access to 230+ lenders.
tagline: Whether you are a first-time buyer or an experienced buyer with excellent credit, Dominion Lending Centres has access to the very best products and rates available across Canada.
